description: Synthesize game sound effects locally from a preset and write 16-bit mono 44.1 kHz WAV files. Free for commercial use, no attribution. Returns file paths, the seed of each variant (reuse it to get the exact same sound) and the patch JSON (edit it and call render_patch to fine-tune). Presets: swordQi, guqin, bell, gong, spell, thunder, lightning, breakthrough, talisman, alchemy, chime, flute, qiGather, pipa, erhu, woodfish, drum, coin, pickup, click, confirm, error, jump, hit, explosion, laser, powerUp, levelUp, whoosh, arrow, swordClash, footstepStone, rain, notify, footstepGrass, land, shieldBlock, wind, campfire, stream, caveDrip, pageTurn, typing, chestOpen, monsterGrowl.

count.description: Number of variants to write (default 1). Useful to let the user pick, or for randomized playback.

js_path.description: Also write a dependency-free .js file with play functions for these sounds (Web Audio, no audio files needed)

loop_seconds.description: Write a seamless loop of about this many seconds instead of a one-shot (the WAV carries a loop point). Only for loopable presets: rain, wind, campfire, stream, drum, caveDrip, thunder, chime, monsterGrowl. Use for background ambience.

mutate.description: Extra random tweak amount on top of the seeded result, 0-1 (e.g. 0.15)

out_path.description: WAV file to write, e.g. "assets/sfx/coin.wav". Relative paths resolve against the server working directory. With count > 1, files get -01, -02 ... suffixes.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible result; variant i uses seed + i

name: generate_sfx
title: Generate sound effect WAV files
